origin: http://127.0.0.1:<selected ephemeral or supplied port>/<access token>/

routes.api/rows: GET pair=<id optional>&classification=<exact optional>&search=<literal key text optional>&offset=0&limit=40 -> {total,offset,limit,rows:[complete ABI row with row_id]}; maximum page500
routes.api/row: GET id=<positive int> -> complete ABI row with row_id
routes.api/source: GET table=<original table id>&record=<positive ordinal afterheader> -> {table,record,headers,values,source:{table,retained_path,bytes,sha256}}; actual csv.reader values including [] for blank physical record
routes.download/rows.jsonl: GET full exact retained export when no query; with pair/classification/search filters, stream ALL matching records, never just the visible page; offset/limit rejected.
routes.download/rows.csv: GET full exact retained export when no query; with pair/classification/search filters, stream ALL matching records, never just the visible page; offset/limit rejected.
routes.download/case.zip: GET verified complete prepacked ZIP (409 if absent; command in UI guide)
routes.api/totals: GET pair=<optional>&field=<optional>&status=<optional>&search=<literal dimensions text>&offset=0&limit=40 -> {total,offset,limit,rows:[complete total record with total_id,pair,dimensions,field,source,target,difference,status,meaning]}; max500
routes.api/total: GET id=<positive int> -> complete total record
routes.download/totals.csv: GET full exact retained export when no query; with pair/field/status/search filters, stream ALL matching records, never just the visible page; offset/limit rejected.
routes.download/totals.jsonl: GET full exact retained export when no query; with pair/field/status/search filters, stream ALL matching records, never just the visible page; offset/limit rejected.

statuses.400: invalid request or changed immutable member

receiving.shutdown: The original launching operator terminates its own process; no remote write/stop API.

security.access: unpredictable per-process path token; exact Host, same Origin when supplied, cross-site browser requests rejected
security.storage: no mutating HTTP methods; downloaded files chosen by operator
security.logs: request paths, keys and access tokens excluded from default HTTP logs
security.source: actual original CSV reader with header and exact full record, including empty records
